note: PG&E campground on the west shore of Lake Almanor near Canyon Dam, between Highway 89 and the lake under ponderosa pines. Many sites sit on the shoreline, and the paved Lake Almanor Recreation Trail runs through. Mixed reservable and first-come sites; the first-come sites are 110-130 plus 23 and 88. --Claude
summary: PG&E reservation site (park 118: description, FAQ, 117 site cards with fees, lengths, FCFS flags and points), site photos, OSM, imagery and Google read. $30/night single, $60 double; 2-14 nights for reservations, 22 first-come sites; reservations open Apr 15. 115 of 117 sites take 24 ft+. Not on PG&E's closure list. Stored pin is 904 m off in the forest west of Hwy 89 - re-pin to the site centroid. Waterfront recommended up from not waterfront to lakefront: the old evidence was measured from the wrong pin. Google 4.1 (119). Website 404 - replace.
flags: WATERFRONT (upgrade, not waterfront -> lakefront): the old waterfront_evidence was measured at 40.1880,-121.1040, the stored pin, which is forest WEST of Hwy 89; the campground is EAST of the highway on the shore. PG&E posts site points: 40 (40.19642,-121.11281) 16 m from the OSM lake outline, 41 (40.19628,-121.11273) 21 m, 50 (40.19575,-121.11167) 16 m, 108 (40.19155,-121.10812) 22 m, 109 (40.19139,-121.10765) 25 m, 120 (40.19152,-121.10568) 9 m, 122 (40.19160,-121.10492) 9 m, 125 (40.19145,-121.10472) 7 m. Imagery shows those spurs ending at the tree line directly above an open sand beach (lake drawn down in the image; the beach is the high-water apron), and PG&E's own photos of 108, 109, 120, 125, 40 and 41 show the spur ending at the water's edge over a low, gentle bank under scattered pines. PG&E: 'Many of the camping spots are on the shoreline of Lake Almanor'. All are sold by the night: 40, 41, 108, 109 reservable at $30 (2-night minimum), 50 a $60 double, 120, 122 (double) and 125 first-come by the night. Replacement evidence: 'PG&E site points: 40/41/50 (40.1960,-121.1125) and 108/109/120/122/125 (40.1915,-121.1060) 7-25 m from Lake Almanor's outline; imagery shows the spurs at the tree line over an open beach, PG&E photos show the lake right off the spur over a low gentle bank. Sold nightly (reserve 2+ nights, or first-come 120/122/125). Lakefront.'
